top_signals.title: Trump’s Russia Diesel Deal Struggles to Find Willing US Buyer
top_signals.summary: An accord brokered by President Donald Trump to sell Russian diesel to the US appears to have failed to clear a key hurdle: finding a willing customer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The world's super-rich are piling into alternative investments. Here's why
top_signals.summary: Alternative investments now account for 60% of single-family office portfolios, surpassing traditional assets for the first time, according to BNY Wealth.
